title: 开挖安全测验
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/29_Excavation Safety Quiz Test Your Safety Knowledge Excavation Safety Quiz Excavat.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/29_Excavation Safety Quiz Test Your Safety Knowledge Excavation Safety Quiz Excavat/src.py

points.K1: 测验规则：十题八对才过
points.K3: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批
points.K5: 最常见的危害：土体失稳

shots.scene: 欣欣戴安全帽站在沟槽围挡外，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a safety helmet stands outside a trench fence and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 开挖安全小测验，来试一试！

shots.scene: 工地办公室里，阿杰坐在电脑前，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: In a site office, the young male student sits at a computer with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 阿杰要准备公司的开挖安全考试。

shots.scene: 老李站在他身后指着屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands behind him and points at the screen.
shots.narration: 老李说：先读要点，再开始答题。

shots.scene: 培训课堂、班前会、安全装备图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a training class, a toolbox meeting and safety equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖作业要培训，开班前安全会。

shots.scene: 安全帽、反光背心、法规书图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hard hat, a reflective vest and a rule book. No people.
shots.narration: 配好安全装备，跟进最新法规。

shots.scene: 一张空白证书和几处工地图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank certificate next to icons of several different work sites. No people.
shots.narration: 网页说，开挖安全证书一般各工地都认。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 屏幕上十格进度条和倒计时
shots.prompt_en: A screen with a ten-segment progress bar and a countdown timer. No people.
shots.narration: 测验十题，限时十分钟，一题约一分钟。
overlay: 测验规则：十题八对才过

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 上一题按钮亮起
shots.prompt_en: A back button lights up on the screen. No people.
shots.narration: 觉得选错了，可以返回去修改。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 倒计时归零，屏幕停住
shots.prompt_en: The countdown reaches zero and the screen freezes. No people.
shots.narration: 十分钟一到，测验自动结束。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 阿杰飞快点完，结果页五绿五红
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clicks through quickly; the result screen shows five green and five red boxes.
shots.narration: 阿杰快速答完，只得了50%。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 进度条在八成处插一面小旗
shots.prompt_en: A progress bar with a flag at four fifths. No people.
shots.narration: 要答对八题、达到80%才能过。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 结果页逐题红绿，旁边重做按钮
shots.prompt_en: The result screen shows each question in red or green, with a restart button. No people.
shots.narration: 往下翻能看到每题正确答案，还能重做。

shots.section_title: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批
shots.scene: 深基坑和支护结构剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a deep pit with shoring. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：深基坑支护设计谁来审批？
overlay: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批

shots.section_title: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批
shots.scene: 工程师、路人、业主家属、工人四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: an engineer with a helmet, a passerby, a family member and workers. No people.
shots.narration: 工程师、路人、业主家属、现场工人。

shots.section_title: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批
shots.scene: 工程师图标亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The engineer icon lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：专业工程师。

shots.scene: 沟槽剖面，旁边量尺
shots.prompt_en: A trench cross-section with a measuring rule beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：“1.5比1规则”是什么意思？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with trench and arrow icons. No people.
shots.narration: 1.5英尺内免支护？每深1英尺宽1.5英尺？

shots.scene: 选项卡片轮流亮起，答案处模糊
shots.prompt_en: The option cards light up in turn; the answer area stays blurred. No people.
shots.narration: 宽是深的1.5倍？不超1.5英尺深？

shots.scene: 欣欣摊手，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shrugs with a question mark icon beside it.
shots.narration: 这一题的正确答案，画面上看不清。

shots.section_title: 最常见的危害：土体失稳
shots.scene: 太阳、咖啡杯、静音、塌方四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a hot sun, a coffee cup, a quiet speaker and a collapsing trench wall. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：哪个是开挖的常见危害？
overlay: 最常见的危害：土体失稳

shots.section_title: 最常见的危害：土体失稳
shots.scene: 塌方图标亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The collapsing wall icon lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：土体失稳。

shots.scene: 工地入口
shots.prompt_en: The entrance to an excavation site. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：进入开挖现场前该做什么？

shots.scene: 媒体、茶点、闲聊会议、检查四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a camera crew, refreshments, a chatting meeting and an inspector with a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 通知媒体、备茶点、开会聊私事、查隐患。

shots.scene: 检查图标亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The inspector icon lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：做现场检查，找出潜在危害。

shots.scene: 四双鞋：人字拖、运动鞋、钢头鞋、凉鞋
shots.prompt_en: Four pairs of shoes: flip-flops, sneakers, steel-toed boots and sandals. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：开挖工人推荐穿什么鞋？

shots.scene: 钢头鞋亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The steel-toed boots light up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：钢头安全鞋。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 十题十分钟，答对八题才算过。

shots.scene: 工程师和塌方图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an engineer and a collapsing wall. No people.
shots.narration: 支护设计找专业工程师，常见危害是失稳。

shots.scene: 检查和钢头鞋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an inspector and steel-toed boots. No people.
shots.narration: 进场先检查，脚上穿安全鞋。

shots.scene: 阿杰点下重做按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clicks the restart button.
shots.narration: 没过就看答案，再做一遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 开挖小测验到这里，下次见！
